subject: Idea for LEIAH
body:
Hi,

I came across LEIAH and spent some time looking through the restaurant. What stood out most was the five-course structure — each course is a distinct step in the progression, and the Mediterranean-American fusion gives the meal a clear identity that most Orlando dining does not have.

From what I saw, the restaurant already looks polished, but I think the content could lean more into the feel of moving through the tasting experience — the room, the pacing, the wine pours — so a viewer feels the occasion rather than just sees the plates.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had for LEIAH would build from the first pour into the final course, using the intimate room and natural light to make the dining experience feel immersive and real.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for LEIAH.

Best,
Malachi
